args.subject: Re: Need to return something to a patient
args.body:
Dear Coşkun,

Thank you for your kind effort to return the item. For privacy reasons, we are unable to share another patient's personal details, including their address or phone number. Our staff have been notified and will contact you shortly to arrange how the item can be returned safely to its owner.

Kind regards,
Nova Dental Clinic reception
